entry.author: New Zealand Trade and Enterprise
entry.summary:
Former CFO and Head of Export for successful nut butter exporter, Fix & Fogg, NZTE Beachhead advisor Sarah Sherriff explains how they used Amazon feedback to test and refine their product offering with US consumers. She also talks about how important competitor, in-store, and data research is when validating your product in a huge market like the US.

Download tools and templates at my.NZTE. https://my.nzte.govt.nz/article/how-to-size-and-segment-your-target-market
